title: Restarting a run
statement: Given an amplified configuration $C$, a run index $j\in\text{Fin}(r+1)$, and a counter $c\in\text{Fin}(r+2)$, restarting produces a configuration that preserves all fields of $C$ except that its phase state becomes run $j$ in the initial state of $N$, with no output summary recorded and counter $c$, and its input-head position is set to $1$.
